Add allocated and unallocated loss adjustment expense and policy maintenance expense to the projection
Apply rate change and loss trend adjustments to bring historical ratios to the unexpired period
Document the source of each assumption and any judgement applied
Reconcile the projected unexpired exposure base to the calculated unearned premium

testing.expected: Projected losses and expenses documented per line with assumption sources recorded

checklistGeneric: Exhibits built from the booked reserve balances
checklistSpecific: Assemble the AOS exhibits showing the actuary point estimate, range, and carried reserves gross and net
Confirm the carried reserve amounts agree to Schedule P and the annual statement
Include the one-year and two-year reserve development exhibits
Include the RMAD conclusion and materiality standard used
Confirm every exhibit is labelled with the company, NAIC code and valuation year

testing.expected: Carried reserve amounts in the AOS exhibits agree to the filed annual statement

checklistSpecific: Compare carried reserves to the actuarial central estimate and to the low and high ends of the reasonable range
Confirm the range derivation method is documented and consistent with prior year
Record the position of carried reserves within the range as a percentage
Escalate any segment where carried reserves fall outside the reasonable range
Document the written conclusion on reserve reasonableness with the actuary name and date

testing.expected: No reserve segment carried outside the range of reasonable estimates without documented escalation

checklistSpecific: Assign a senior actuary independent of the segment preparer to perform the review
Review data reconciliation, factor selections, method weights and selected ultimates for each segment
Log each review challenge with the preparer response and resolution
Confirm all review points are closed or accepted before reserves are booked
Record the reviewer name, review date and overall conclusion in the peer review log

testing.location: Reserve peer review log for the period
testing.expected: Independent reviewer recorded with all review points closed before booking

checklistGeneric: Timetable aligned to the filing deadline
checklistSpecific: Agree the scope, segments and reliance basis with the external actuarial firm in the engagement letter
Confirm the external actuary qualification and independence documentation is on file
Agree the data and work paper handover timetable against the statutory filing deadline
Track delivery of the external firm draft opinion and resolve queries
Confirm the external opinion conclusion is consistent with the internal reserve analysis before issue

testing.expected: Signed engagement letter and independence confirmation on file for the opinion year

checklistGeneric: Drafted to the prescribed NAIC opinion format
checklistSpecific: Draft the SAO identification, scope, opinion and relevant comment sections in the prescribed format
State the reliance on data and on other parties with names and roles
State the materiality standard and the RMAD conclusion
Confirm the scope paragraph reserve amounts agree to the annual statement Schedule P and Exhibit A
Circulate the draft for internal review and log the review comments and resolutions

testing.expected: Draft contains identification, scope, reliance, opinion and RMAD sections with amounts tying to the annual statement

checklistGeneric: Filing made from the signed opinion
checklistSpecific: Confirm the opinion filed is the signed final version with the actuary signature and date
File the SAO with the domiciliary state and all states requiring separate submission
Confirm the Actuarial Opinion Summary is filed separately and confidentially where required
Record the filing date, states filed and confirmation reference for each submission
Confirm no filing deadline is missed across the required state list

testing.location: SAO filing register for the opinion year
testing.expected: No required state showing an unfiled or overdue Statement of Actuarial Opinion

checklistGeneric: All review points closed before signature
checklistSpecific: Confirm the actuarial report and supporting memorandum are complete before signing
Confirm the Appointed Actuary qualification standard statement is included
Sign and date the opinion and record the signature in the opinion register
Release the signed opinion with the supporting actuarial report to Finance and the regulator filing team
Lock the signed version and prevent further edits to the released document

testing.expected: Signed and dated opinion released with the supporting actuarial report attached

checklistSpecific: Archive the signed opinion, actuarial report, AOS exhibits, work papers and peer review evidence
Tag the archive with the opinion year, company and NAIC code
Confirm the archive is complete against the opinion documentation checklist
Apply the statutory retention period and any legal-hold flag
Confirm the archive is retrievable for regulatory examination within the required response time

testing.location: Actuarial opinion archive for the opinion year
testing.expected: Complete opinion pack archived with retention period applied and retrievable for examination

checklistSpecific: Build the reserve roll-forward: opening reserve plus incurred less paid equals closing reserve, by segment
Split incurred between current accident year and prior accident year development
Confirm opening and closing balances agree to the general ledger reserve accounts
Explain every segment where prior-year development exceeds the materiality threshold
Confirm the roll-forward ties to the paid loss and case reserve movement in the claims data

testing.expected: Opening plus incurred less paid equals closing reserve for every segment and agrees to the GL

checklistGeneric: Pack circulated ahead of the committee
checklistSpecific: Prepare the Reserve Committee pack with point estimate, range, carried reserves and adequacy conclusion
Present the prior-year development results and the drivers of adverse or favourable movement
Present the RMAD conclusion and the materiality standard applied
Record the committee decision to accept the carried reserves and the opinion conclusion
Log committee challenges and actions with owners and due dates

testing.location: Reserve Committee meeting pack and minutes
testing.expected: Minutes record the committee decision on carried reserves and the adequacy conclusion

checklistSpecific: Quantify one-year reserve development for each accident year and line of business
Separate favourable and adverse development and identify the largest contributors
Attribute development to claim-level drivers such as large losses, settlements and case reserve strengthening
Confirm the total development ties to the prior-year development shown in the reserve roll-forward
Compare development to the Schedule P development exhibits for consistency

testing.expected: Development quantified by accident year and line and tying to the reserve roll-forward prior-year development

checklistGeneric: Report distributed before the committee meeting
Root cause stated for each material change
checklistSpecific: Prepare the Audit Committee report on material reserve changes with amounts by segment
State the root cause of each material strengthening or release
Confirm the amounts reported agree to the booked reserve movement and the roll-forward
Describe the remediation or monitoring actions where the change reflects a process or data issue
Distribute the report through the board portal ahead of the meeting and log the distribution

testing.expected: Report posted ahead of the meeting with root-cause explanation for each material reserve change

checklistSpecific: Compute paid-to-incurred, reserve-to-premium, reserve-to-surplus and survival ratios by line
Trend each ratio over the last eight to twelve quarters and flag directional shifts
Compare the ratios to industry benchmarks where available for the line
Investigate and document any ratio outside the expected band for the line
Carry the ratio conclusions into the reserve adequacy write-up

testing.expected: Paid-to-incurred and reserve-to-premium ratios trended by line with outliers flagged

checklistSpecific: Set and document the materiality standard used for the RMAD assessment and its basis
Identify the major risk factors that could produce material adverse deviation by line
Quantify the potential adverse deviation using the reserve variability or range analysis
Compare the potential deviation to the materiality standard and state the RMAD conclusion
Document the risk factors to be disclosed in the relevant comment section of the opinion

testing.expected: Materiality standard, risk factors and RMAD conclusion documented for the opinion year

checklistGeneric: Archive completed after the quarterly close
checklistSpecific: Archive the ceded reserve calculation, treaty mapping, ceded triangles and recoverable schedules for the period
Attach the treaty correspondence and reinsurer confirmations relied on in the analysis
Tag the archive with reporting period, treaty year and preparer
Apply the statutory retention period and legal-hold flag
Confirm the archive is retrievable for regulatory examination and external audit

testing.location: Ceded reserve archive for the reporting period
testing.expected: Ceded reserve analysis and treaty correspondence archived with retention applied

checklistSpecific: List recoverables by reinsurer with current financial strength rating and authorised/unauthorised status
Confirm collateral held (letters of credit, funds withheld, trusts) for each unauthorised reinsurer
Age the recoverable balances and flag amounts overdue beyond the treaty settlement terms
Identify reinsurers in run-off, downgraded or in dispute and assess recovery risk
Document a collectability conclusion and provision recommendation for each reinsurer

testing.location: Recoverable balances by reinsurer with rating and collateral
testing.expected: Every reinsurer carries a current rating, collateral position and collectability conclusion

checklistGeneric: Calculation run on the reconciled ceded data
checklistSpecific: Calculate gross and ceded ultimate losses and IBNR by treaty layer and accident year
Apply treaty attachment points, limits, retentions and reinstatement terms in the ceded calculation
Compute the reinsurance recoverable on unpaid losses as ceded ultimate less ceded paid
Confirm ceded reserves do not exceed the treaty limit for any layer or accident year
Reconcile net reserves to gross less ceded for every segment and accident year

testing.location: Ceded reserve calculation by treaty layer
testing.expected: No ceded reserve exceeding the treaty limit for any layer or accident year

testing.location: Gross, ceded and net reserve summary
testing.expected: Net reserves equal gross less ceded for every segment and accident year

checklistSpecific: Produce the actuarial valuation of the reserves subject to the proposed commutation by accident year
Compare the commutation offer to the discounted and undiscounted actuarial reserve estimate
Quantify the reserve release and profit or loss impact of the proposed commutation
Agree the negotiating position and walk-away value with Reinsurance and Finance
Record the agreed position and the approval required before the commutation is executed

testing.expected: Actuarial valuation of commuted reserves documented alongside the offer and the resulting P&L impact

checklistGeneric: Listing produced at the reporting date
checklistSpecific: Query open claims and identify those with treaty or facultative reinsurance coverage attached
Confirm each identified claim carries the correct treaty year and treaty code
Identify claims with incurred amounts approaching the treaty attachment point
Investigate claims above the attachment point with no reinsurance code attached
Produce the reconciled listing of reinsured open claims for the ceded reserve calculation

testing.system: Claims management platform (Guidewire ClaimCenter/Duck Creek Claims)
testing.location: Open claim listing with reinsurance coverage flags
testing.expected: No open claim above a treaty attachment point lacking a reinsurance coverage attachment

checklistGeneric: Mapping built from the executed treaty wording
checklistSpecific: Map each in-force and run-off treaty to the reserve segments and lines of business it covers
Record attachment point, limit, retention, cession percentage and treaty period for each mapping
Confirm the mapping reflects the executed treaty slip and wording, not the draft
Identify reserve segments with no treaty coverage and confirm this is expected
Version the mapping file and record the effective period and approver

testing.expected: Every active treaty mapped to reserve segments with attachment, limit and cession recorded

checklistGeneric: Status refreshed on the agreed cycle
checklistSpecific: Produce the aged recoverable balance report by reinsurer and treaty at the reporting date
Flag balances overdue beyond the contractual settlement period
Confirm cash received in the period has been applied against the correct billing and treaty
Escalate disputed or unresponded billings to the reinsurance operations team with a due date
Update the collection status and expected recovery date for every overdue balance

testing.expected: Every recoverable balance carries an ageing bucket and a current collection status

checklistGeneric: Notification thresholds defined in the treaty
Notifications sent within the contractual window
checklistSpecific: Identify claims whose incurred amount has reached the treaty notification threshold or attachment point
Confirm the notification requirement and time limit in the applicable treaty wording
Send the loss notification to the reinsurer with the claim details and reserve estimate
Record the notification date, recipient and reference against the claim and treaty
Confirm no reinsured claim has breached its notification deadline without notice being sent

testing.expected: No claim past the treaty notification deadline without a recorded notification

checklistGeneric: Triangles built from reconciled ceded data
checklistSpecific: Build ceded paid and incurred triangles by accident year for each active treaty
Confirm the latest diagonal agrees to the ceded balances in the reinsurance system
Confirm the triangle basis (treaty year or accident year) is consistent with the treaty structure
Flag treaties with too few data points for credible development and note the alternative approach
Retain the triangles with the ceded reserve work papers for the period

testing.expected: Ceded triangle latest diagonal agrees to the reinsurance system ceded paid and incurred balances

checklistGeneric: Report produced to the quarterly timetable
checklistSpecific: Produce the quarterly ceded reserve report showing ceded case, IBNR and recoverable by treaty
Include the quarter movement in ceded reserves with driver commentary
Confirm the reported ceded balances agree to the general ledger and the reinsurance system
Include the collectability and bad-debt provision summary
Distribute to Finance and Reinsurance and record the distribution date and recipients

testing.expected: Ceded reserve balances in the report agree to the general ledger for the reporting period

checklistGeneric: Provision supported by the collectability assessment
Posting evidenced in the close file
checklistSpecific: Calculate the uncollectible provision by reinsurer using the documented provisioning matrix
Apply higher provisioning rates to unauthorised, unrated, downgraded and disputed balances
Offset collateral held (letters of credit, funds withheld, trusts) before provisioning
Obtain approval of the provision per the write-off and provision authority matrix
Post the provision entry and reconcile the provision balance to the collectability schedule

testing.expected: Posted provision agrees to the collectability assessment schedule and carries the required approval

checklistSpecific: Reconcile ceded reserve balances in the actuarial summary to the reinsurance system balances
Reconcile reinsurance recoverable balances to the accounts receivable balances in the general ledger
Reconcile to the reinsurer settlement statements and account current for the period
Investigate and clear reconciling items above the agreed threshold and age those remaining
Obtain reviewer sign-off on the completed reconciliation before close

testing.location: Reinsurance recoverable GL account versus reinsurance system
testing.expected: No unexplained reconciling item above threshold between the GL and the reinsurance system
Settlement statement balances reconciled and signed off for the period

checklistSpecific: Track external audit requests for reinsurance recoverables on the PBC list with owners and due dates
Provide the ceded reserve calculation, treaty mapping and collectability assessment as requested
Provide the reconciliation of recoverables to the general ledger and settlement statements
Review each response for accuracy and completeness before release to the auditor
Log audit findings on recoverables and track remediation actions to closure

testing.expected: No open external audit request on recoverables past its agreed due date
